title: Sweets and Slices Greenwich Village Walking Food Tour
blurb:
Get a taste of New York City's best food and historical sights with this delicious Greenwich Village walking tour hosted by a native New Yorker!

We'll walk the streets of one of New York's most beloved neighborhoods and sample some iconic sweets and slices from award-winning restaurants (curated by someone who's lived in the Big Apple for over 25 years!)

You'll be able to try some amazing food:
- Banana pudding
- Pizza from a third-generation pizza maker's slice shop
- A life-changing cookie that gives back to the community
- A New Yorker's take on a margherita pizza
- An award-winning cupcake

We'll also see some iconic sights:
- Taylor Swift's old apartment
- Washington Square park
- The FRIENDS apartment building
- Carrie Bradshaw's apartment as seen in "Sex and the City"
